infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Open Outdoor uses your location while the map is open to show your position as a GPS dot, and while you explicitly record an outdoor activity.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Open Outdoor uses Always Location only to continue an outdoor activity you explicitly started while the screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Open Outdoor uses barometer data during an active recording to improve elevation estimates.
